title: An ELBO and a protocol boundary
promptMarkdown: For a latent modelpθ(x, z)=p (z) pθ(x|z), derive logpθ(x)=ELBO(q)+KL(q (z|x)||pθ(z|x)) whereELBO=Eq logpθ(x|z)−KL(q||p). State support/integrability assumptions sufficient for the derivation. Explain why fitting an autoencoder on all train/validation/test inputs before a frozen linear probe is a different protocol from fitting it on training inputs only, even without test labels. Design a matched-data comparison between random, reconstruction-trained and contrastively trained encoders that keeps downstream selection and test evaluation separate.
hintLadder: Substitute Bayes into the posterior KL and rearrange.
Name which data influenced the encoder, not just which labels influenced the probe.
Match input access and probe capacity while reporting different training costs.
